decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">The proposed two storey side to rear extension together with the existing hip to gable&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">roof extension and rear dormer, by reason of their excessive combined&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">bulk and massing,&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">would form an incongruous,&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">discordant, unduly bulky and dominant addition to the host dwelling&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">and street scene which would fail to respect the prevailing character of the locality, contrary to the high quality&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">D3.D(1) and D3.D(11) of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch, Single and two storey side to rear extension (Demolition of side extension)
